drivers.rationale: An initial application with a small operations team
Orders, payments and inventory must remain cohesive modules
Order and charge invariants need well-defined transactions
No documented need for independent service releases
Inventory and status notifications can be asynchronous

scenarios.stimulus: An unauthorized actor requests payment or order modification
scenarios.expected_response: Deny unauthorized operations across the payments-to-identity boundary
scenarios.measure: An architecture review traces the authorization check and failure behavior at the boundary

scenarios.stimulus: Client repeats the same payment request after a timeout
scenarios.expected_response: Reuse the same payment intent and avoid a duplicate charge
scenarios.measure: Architecture review verifies idempotency key lifecycle and retry semantics
